purpose: Use the already-trusted repository-scoped WIF deployer in read-only mode to test iam.serviceAccounts.actAs against every provider-verified Owner/Project-IAM-Admin service account and read the runtime identities of known Federation Cloud Run control services. Determine whether an existing least-privilege Cloud Run actAs bridge can execute the exact three Gemini ADC bindings automatically without granting the deployer IAM-admin authority, creating credentials, or widening WIF.
truth_boundary: Read-only provider census only. Do not change IAM, WIF, service accounts, API enablement, Artifact Registry contents, Cloud Run services or traffic; do not build or push an image, run Gemini inference, access secret payloads, send communications, publish, spend, or perform destructive actions. An actAs grant is only a route candidate until provider-native testIamPermissions proves it for a verified high-authority service account.
